library.description: Native SQLite storage backend with transactional SQL

blocks.text: English
当本地设置、离线记录和缓存需要一起保存时，本包把文本、记录、过期时间与应用 SQL 统一放进运行时内置的 SQLite 事务，避免多个更新只成功一部分。选择 Node 或 Bun 对应的驱动和数据库文件，再把插件安装到 host；无需另装 npm 原生数据库扩展，连接由应用创建和关闭。

items: 本地设置写了一半：几个更新各自提交，中途失败没有回滚。
两个进程同时改同一项：只有内存锁，另一个进程看不到。
到期缓存仍被当成有效数据：值和期限分开保存，读取时没有统一处理。
事务还在运行，根查询却抢了连接：同一连接混用了事务内外操作。
数据与期限一起写。 批量值、记录和 TTL 在同一个原生事务内更新，见一起保存值和期限。
应用 SQL 与存储方法共用事务。 使用同一 tx，SQL 与 KV 可以共同提交或回滚，见把应用-sql-和存储修改一起提交。
连接释放顺序明确。 你创建连接，host 使用它；先释放 host，再释放连接。Node/Bun 使用各自内置模块，不增加 npm 原生 addon。
并发限制说清楚。 文件 WAL 模式支持跨连接逻辑锁；非 WAL 模式只在当前进程协调，见并发与取消。不以此声称更快。

blocks.text: 下面在真正的 SQLite 内存数据库中写入并读取。持久保存时把 `:memory:` 换成文件路径。Node 需要24或更新版本。
预期输出：
多项数据共同保存，看一起保存值和期限；文件备份看备份数据库文件。
下面假定应用表已存在，只展示，不执行。
使用 `store.transaction`，并且在回调里只使用 tx。被捕获或未 await 的数据操作失败，仍会使该事务回滚。

rows: 打开与关闭 SQLite 文件
使用文件中的标准存储

blocks.text: 能力令牌标识一组方法；Feature 是额外安装的功能。WAL 是 SQLite 把变更先记入旁边日志文件的模式，允许本包通过共享文件协调逻辑锁。

rows: 业务表与设置共同更新
导出可重新打开的备份

blocks.text: 当前包 `private: true`，用于本仓库工作区。它不是公共 registry 发布承诺。消费包中添加：
Node 24+ 与 Deno 使用 `/node` 的 `nodeSqliteDriver(path)`；Bun 使用 `/bun` 的 `bunSqliteDriver(path)`。Deno 需要数据库及其日志文件的读写权限。子入口明确选择运行时，不自动回退。根入口不加载任何数据库驱动。

rows: 标准数据、查询、期限与计数
同一连接中的原生事务

blocks.text: 每个 driver 同时只交给一个 store；多个连接可以使用同一个文件。文件库默认 WAL，内存库默认非 WAL；内存库要求 WAL 会拒绝。默认表前缀 `migaia`，默认锁期限30000ms，无 heartbeat。事务占用连接时根操作会失败，应改用 tx。
本包不提供向量、RDF 或实时变更流。记录字段查询在客户端求值；取消不能抢占已经开始的同步 SQLite 工作。错误、数据类型、维护与日志的详细限制见 USEGUIDE。
English
Node 24+ 使用下列完整示例；Bun 把驱动入口换为 `/bun` 的 `bunSqliteDriver`。文件示例会写入当前目录，先确认目录可写。先创建 connection，再创建 host，离开作用域时会先释放 host。

rows: 值、记录与期限需要共同保存
应用表和 KV 必须共同回滚
把应用 SQL 和存储修改一起提交
需要一个独立备份文件
多连接写入或取消等待

blocks.text: 示例在文件中使用固定组织，预期输出 `ready`、`1`、`true`。

blocks.code:
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { kv, records, ttl, counter } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { lockKey } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sqliteBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite'
import { nodeSqliteDriver } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite/node'
await using connection = nodeSqliteDriver('./example-settings.sqlite')
await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sqliteBackendPlugin({ driver: connection })] as const
})
const store = host.org('10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001').backend('sqlite')
await store
  .tx()
  .lock(lockKey.text('example:status'))
  .run(async (tx) => {
    await tx.use(kv).setMany([
      { key: 'example:status', value: 'ready' },
      { key: ['example', 1], value: 'first', ttlMs: 60000 }
    ])
    await tx.putRecord({ name: 'Ada' }, 'example:user')
    await tx.use(ttl).expire(lockKey.text('example:status'), 60000)
    await tx.set('example:count', '0')
    await tx.use(counter).increment('example:count')
  })
console.log(await store.get('example:status'))
console.log(await store.get('example:count'))
console.log((await store.use(records).query().all()).length >= 1)

blocks.text: 组织 ID 是 UUID。所有组织共用连接和物理表；逻辑键、期限、修订与锁按组织隔离。访问组织不会开新连接或创建新表。`host.dropOrg(id)` 只删除相应组织的托管数据，不删除应用表。显式组织视图不提供任意 SQL 或数据库维护。
`setMany` 的 ttlMs 为有限非负毫秒；零立即过期，省略时保留活值期限，新值没有期限。`getMany` 保留输入顺序、重复和缺失位置，缺失为 undefined；重复写键在 I/O 前拒绝。批次写入和删除同事务成功或回滚；删除返回实际数量，分块读取使用同一快照。每批一次 pipeline 和计数观察，空批不做原生操作。
TTL 使用本地 Date.now，值和期限共同写入。覆盖活值保留期限；删除、清空、跨通道替换清掉旧期限。读取、枚举、记录查询会惰性清理过期行，不启动 timer。事务观察过的活值在提交前过期时，会进入冲突处理，不能以旧观察继续提交。counter 从缺失的0开始，只接受规范十进制与安全整数，非法文本和溢出在写入前拒绝。

sections.id: 把应用-sql-和存储修改一起提交
sections.heading: 把应用 SQL 和存储修改一起提交

blocks.text: 该内存库示例先创建自己的应用表。预期输出为 `Ada`、`1`。
SQL 插值绑定为参数；标识符用 sqlFragment.id，组合片段使用同一 SQL 工具。只接受单条语句及可选末尾分号；事务控制和 journal_mode 修改会拒绝，请使用 transaction。带内部语句列表的完整 trigger body 不在此入口范围。行类型由调用方声明，不检查列名或转换 Date。

安全整数读为 number，其余整数保留 bigint。boolean 输入绑定成0/1，BLOB 返回独立 Uint8Array。run 的 changes、lastInsertRowid 是 number或bigint，SQLite 总有 lastInsertRowid。标准 sql 令牌与原生 store.sql 使用同一标签。Statement 缓存最多64项；Node 缓存淘汰不代表立即 finalize。
事务占用连接时，根读取、同步方法与根 SQL 报 TRANSACTION_FAILED；请在回调内使用 tx。回调结束后 tx 失效；未 await 或已 catch 的操作失败仍使事务回滚。取消后也要等已开始的原生工作结束，再回滚和释放锁，不能强行抢占同步语句或忽略取消的回调。
显式选择维护 Feature。示例写一项状态，并创建一个新的备份文件；预期输出 `ready`。每次使用不同文件名，避免覆盖。

blocks.code:
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { sqliteBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite'
import { nodeSqliteDriver } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite/node'
import { sqliteMaintenanceFeature } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite/features/maintenance'
await using connection = nodeSqliteDriver('./example-settings.sqlite')
await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [
    sqliteBackendPlugin({ driver: connection }, { maintenance: sqliteMaintenanceFeature() })
  ] as const
})
const store = host.backend('sqlite')
await store.set('example:backup', 'ready')
await store.api.maintenance.backup(`./example-backup-${crypto.randomUUID()}.sqlite`)
console.log(await store.get('example:backup'))

blocks.text: backup 使用 VACUUM INTO，要求目标不存在且路径可写，不预删、不覆盖。原生失败可能留下不完整文件；取消也不能证明文件未被写入。vacuum 整理当前库。维护只在根 store.api.maintenance 出现，不在 tx.api 或组织视图出现。应用自定义 Feature 可以选择事务 API；其 SQL 和 KV 同事务，失败不会被方法外层 catch 掩盖。
文件库默认 wal:true，安装会请求并确认实际模式；已有 journal_mode=OFF 的连接拒绝。内存库默认 false，显式 true 拒绝。wal:false 保留真实 BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK，但逻辑锁只协调当前进程，不承诺跨进程。
通过 tx().lock(lockKey.text(...)).run 使用逻辑键锁。锁策略从 `@migaia/storage-host/sdk` 选择。只有相同逻辑键才产生逻辑冲突；SQLite writer 串行等待不是业务键冲突。inspectLocks 返回实际持锁方和过期信息。maxLockMs 默认30000ms，无 heartbeat，取消是协作式。

文本、字节、记录分别保存，但同键跨通道写入默认 DUPLICATE_KEY。明确 conflictPolicy:'replace' 才原子替换；同通道更新直接覆盖。文本/字节缺失为 null，记录/metadata 缺失为 undefined。keys 只列文本字符串键，clearAll 保留 metadata，单通道清空不影响其它通道。文本可保留 NUL 和孤立 UTF-16 代理项；记录/metadata 使用支持 Map/Set 的集合编码，非便携值在改表前拒绝，字节读写复制。

driver 必填；table 默认 migaia；concurrency 选择冲突策略，maxLockMs 是锁期限。一个 store 独占使用 driver，但不负责关闭它。多连接可共用文件，不能同时把同一 driver 交给两个 store。Feature 借用的 exec/prepare 客户端不含关闭权。dispose 重复返回相同主 Promise，符号释放有独立的报告型 Promise，两者共享一次清理；失败后仍终止。

本包错误 source 为 @migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite，码为 SQLITE_FAILED、TRANSACTION_FAILED、DUPLICATE_KEY、DECODE_FAILED。校验、取消、超时和并发使用共享错误码。原生或编码错误保留在 cause；回滚也失败时，aggregate errors 首项保留主错误。解码失败不自动修补数据。向量和 RDF 不支持，对应锁在原生调用前报 UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY；不提供变更流或服务端记录字段索引。

通过 `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/journal` 的 `storageJournalPlugin(options)` 显式启用。完整值、每次实际修改和绝对期限在 SQLite 事务中捕获，保留同键多写与中间值。undo 先锁定并检查全部目标的最终修订和镜像，再恢复；恢复原绝对期限，不刷新过期数据。组织重建或非 WAL 本地协调组重新打开后，旧镜像不能继续使用。metadata 不产生业务修改日志。
外置 binlog 在提交后写入，失败报告但不能撤回数据。支持的 WAL 组合使用与数据共同提交的 marker，恢复不重放已提交修改。raw SQL 无完整标准镜像目标，选择提交日志时在执行前拒绝。全局 journal 使用异步 pipeline，因此同步入口报 ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY；普通无日志安装仍有同步 API。

`storageLogStore` 从 `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/journal` 单独导入，可在初始化器内打开同库日志。内存连接的同 namespace 日志独占使用，释放后可重开；文件日志每次在 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 中读取当前索引，允许多连接共用。业务 clear 不清私有日志。选中提交日志时，读取触发的惰性过期删除也进入日志；仅遥测或初始化器不启用该写入行为。遥测每个根操作或完整事务只发一条，logger 与日志载体仍由调用方在 host 之后释放。
中文

When local settings, offline records and caches must be saved together, this module combines text, records, expiry and application SQL in the runtime's built-in SQLite transaction, avoiding partially saved updates. Choose the Node or Bun driver and a database file, then install the plugin in a host. No npm native database extension is needed; your application creates and closes the connection.

items: A settings update is only half saved: each statement committed separately.
Two processes change the same item: an in-memory lock cannot coordinate them.
Expired cache data still looks valid: values and deadlines follow different write paths.
A root query runs during a transaction: both are trying to use one connection.
Write data and expiry together. Batch values, records and TTL share one native transaction. See Save values with expiry.
Combine application SQL with storage methods. Use the same tx to commit or roll back SQL and KV together. See Commit SQL and storage together.
Keep connection cleanup explicit. Your application creates the connection; release the host before releasing it. Node and Bun use built-in modules, with no npm native addon.

Understand concurrency limits. File WAL mode coordinates logical locks across connections. Non-WAL mode coordinates only within the current process. See Concurrency and cancellation. No speed claim is made.

blocks.text: This writes to a real SQLite in-memory database. Replace `:memory:` with a filename to persist data. Node 24 or later is required.
Expected output:
For a multi-value update, see Save values with expiry. To create a database backup, see Back up a database.
This function assumes its application tables already exist. It is shown without execution.
Use `store.transaction` and use only tx inside its callback. A caught or unawaited data-operation failure still causes rollback.

rows: Open and close the SQLite file
Use standard storage in that database
Select KV, records, SQL, expiry or counters
Back up or compact the file

blocks.text: A capability token selects a set of methods. A Feature is an optional addition. WAL is SQLite's write-ahead log mode; here it also enables shared-file coordination for logical locks.
This module is currently `private: true` for use within the repository workspace, rather than a promise of public registry availability. Add it to a consuming workspace module:

Node 24+ and Deno use `nodeSqliteDriver(path)` from `/node`. Bun uses `bunSqliteDriver(path)` from `/bun`. Deno needs read/write permission for the database and its journal files. Entry selection is explicit; no runtime fallback occurs. The root entry loads no database SDK.

rows: Standard values, queries, expiry and counters
Native transactions on the same connection

blocks.text: Give one driver to only one store at a time; multiple connections may open the same file. Files default to WAL and in-memory databases default to non-WAL. Requesting WAL for an in-memory database rejects. The default table prefix is `migaia`. Lock leases default to 30000ms without heartbeat. While a transaction occupies the connection, root operations fail; use tx instead.

Vectors, RDF and live change feeds are not provided. Record field queries evaluate on the client. Cancellation cannot preempt synchronous SQLite work already in progress. See Data and failures for data types, maintenance, logging and error details.
中文

These are complete Node 24+ programs. In Bun, use `bunSqliteDriver` from `/bun`. File examples write in the current directory, which must be writable. Create the connection before the host so scope cleanup releases the host first.

rows: Save values, records and deadlines together
Roll back application SQL and KV together

const store = host.org('10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001').backend('sqlite')

    await tx.use(kv).setMany([

    ])

blocks.text: Organization IDs are UUID strings. Organizations share one connection and the physical tables; keys, expiry, revisions and locks remain separate. Accessing an organization opens no extra connection or table. `host.dropOrg(id)` removes only that organization's managed rows, never application tables. Explicit organization views provide neither arbitrary SQL nor maintenance.

`setMany` accepts finite nonnegative ttlMs. Zero expires immediately; omission keeps a live deadline and gives a new value no deadline. `getMany` retains input order, duplicates and undefined missing positions. Equivalent duplicate write keys reject before I/O. Batch writes/deletes commit or roll back together; deletes return actual counts, and chunked reads share one snapshot. One batch enters its pipeline and count observation once; an empty batch performs no native work.

TTL uses local Date.now and is written with the value. Replacing a live value retains expiry; removal, clear and cross-channel replacement remove the old deadline. Reads, enumeration and record queries clean expired rows lazily, without timers. A value observed alive and then expired before commit enters conflict handling instead of committing a stale observation. Counters start missing values at 0 and accept only canonical decimal text and safe integers; invalid text or overflow reject before writes.
This creates its own application table in an in-memory database. Expected output: `Ada`, `1`.

SQL interpolation binds values; use sqlFragment.id for identifiers and the same SQL tools for fragment composition. One statement with an optional trailing semicolon is accepted. Transaction-control statements and journal_mode changes reject: use transaction instead. Complete trigger bodies containing internal statement lists are outside this endpoint. Row types are caller declarations, with no column validation or Date conversion.

Safe integers read as number; larger integers remain bigint. Boolean inputs become 0/1; BLOB results are independent Uint8Array values. Both changes and lastInsertRowid are number or bigint, and SQLite always supplies lastInsertRowid. The standard sql token uses the same native tag. Statement caching is bounded to 64 entries; evicting a Node entry does not immediately finalize its native statement.

While a transaction uses the connection, root reads, synchronous methods and root SQL fail with TRANSACTION_FAILED. Use tx inside the callback. A saved tx expires when the callback ends. Caught and unawaited operation failures still roll back. Cancellation waits for started work to settle before rollback and lock release; it cannot preempt a synchronous statement or a callback that ignores cancellation.
Select the maintenance Feature explicitly. This writes a status and creates a new backup filename each run. Expected output: `ready`.

blocks.code:
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { sqliteBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite'
import { nodeSqliteDriver } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite/node'
import { sqliteMaintenanceFeature } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite/features/maintenance'
await using connection = nodeSqliteDriver('./example-settings.sqlite')
await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [
    sqliteBackendPlugin({ driver: connection }, { maintenance: sqliteMaintenanceFeature() })
  ] as const
})
const store = host.backend('sqlite')
await store.set('example:backup', 'ready')
await store.api.maintenance.backup(`./example-backup-${crypto.randomUUID()}.sqlite`)

blocks.text: Backup uses VACUUM INTO. The destination must not exist and must be writable; it is neither deleted nor overwritten first. Failure may leave a partial file. Cancellation cannot prove that no file was written. Vacuum compacts the current database. Maintenance appears only on root store.api.maintenance, never on tx.api or organization views. Application Features may provide transaction APIs; their SQL and KV participate in that same transaction, including failure tracking.

Files default to wal:true; installation requests and verifies the actual mode. Connections already using journal_mode=OFF reject. In-memory databases default to false and reject explicit true. wal:false still uses real BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, but its logical locks coordinate only the current process.

Use tx().lock(lockKey.text(...)).run for explicit logical locks. Select policies from `@migaia/storage-host/sdk`. Only matching logical keys conflict; SQLite's physical writer wait is not a business-key conflict. inspectLocks returns actual holders and expiry. maxLockMs defaults to 30000ms, without heartbeat. Cancellation is cooperative.

Text, bytes and records use separate channels, but another channel holding the same key causes DUPLICATE_KEY. Explicit conflictPolicy:'replace' replaces it atomically; same-channel writes overwrite normally. Missing text/bytes return null and missing records/metadata return undefined. keys lists only text string keys; clearAll retains metadata; clearing one channel leaves the others alone. Text retains NUL and lone UTF-16 surrogates. Records/metadata use collection-aware encoding including Map/Set. Nonportable values reject before table modification; byte inputs and outputs are copied.

Driver is required; table defaults to migaia. concurrency selects conflict behavior and maxLockMs bounds the lease. A store uses the driver exclusively but never closes it. Separate connections may share a file; one driver cannot serve two stores concurrently. Feature clients expose exec/prepare without disposal. Repeated dispose returns the same main Promise; symbolic cleanup has a separate report-only Promise, sharing one real cleanup. The store stays terminal after cleanup failure.

module failures use source @migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite and SQLITE_FAILED, TRANSACTION_FAILED, DUPLICATE_KEY or DECODE_FAILED. Shared validation, cancellation, timeout and conflict codes retain their source. Original failures remain on cause; aggregate errors keep the primary failure first if rollback also fails. Decode errors never repair data automatically. Vectors and RDF are unsupported, including their lock targets before native I/O. No live change feed or server-side record-field index is provided.

Enable journals explicitly with `storageJournalPlugin(options)` from `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/journal`. SQLite captures complete values, every actual mutation and absolute expiry inside the data transaction, retaining repeated writes and intermediate values. Undo locks and checks every target's final revision/image before restoring. It restores original absolute deadlines, without extending expired data. Recreated organizations and reopened non-WAL coordination groups cannot reuse old undo images. Metadata is excluded from business mutation logs.

External binlog append happens after commit; failure reports but cannot undo committed data. Supported WAL combinations use a marker committed with the data, and recovery does not replay known committed changes. Raw SQL has no complete standard-image target and rejects before execution when commit logging is selected. Global journal configuration uses an asynchronous pipeline, so synchronous entries fail with ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY; installations without journals retain synchronous APIs.

Import storageLogStore separately from `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/journal`; an initializer can open a journal in the same database. An in-memory connection exclusively uses a journal namespace until release. File journals read current indexes inside each BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and allow multiple connections. Business clear operations leave private journals intact. With commit logging selected, expiry cleanup triggered by reads is logged too; telemetry-only or initializer-only configurations do not enable this mutation logging. Telemetry records each root operation or whole transaction once. The application releases the logger and its storage after releasing the host.

symbols.signature: export declare function nodeSqliteDriver(path: string): ISqliteConnection;
symbols.purpose: Open the native Node/Deno SQLite connection with exact integers.
symbols.core:
path: Native database filename or :memory: for a private memory database.
A caller-owned synchronous driver and storage resource, without a public native Database or close method.
examples:
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { kv, records, ttl, counter } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { lockKey } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sqliteBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite'
import { nodeSqliteDriver } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sqlite/node'
await using connection = nodeSqliteDriver('./example-settings.sqlite')
await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sqliteBackendPlugin({ driver: connection })] as const
})
const store = host.org('10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001').backend('sqlite')
await store
  .tx()
  .lock(lockKey.text('example:status'))
  .run(async (tx) => {
    await tx.use(kv).setMany([
      { key: 'example:status', value: 'ready' },
      { key: ['example', 1], value: 'first', ttlMs: 60000 }
    ])
    await tx.putRecord({ name: 'Ada' }, 'example:user')
    await tx.use(ttl).expire(lockKey.text('example:status'), 60000)
    await tx.set('example:count', '0')
    await tx.use(counter).increment('example:count')
  })
console.log(await store.get('example:status'))
console.log(await store.get('example:count'))
console.log((await store.use(records).query().all()).length >= 1)
